text_en: In those days John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness of Judea, proclaiming,
text_cn: 那时，洗者若翰出现在犹太旷野宣讲，

text_en: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near. ”
text_cn: 说：“你们悔改吧！因为天国临近了。”

text_en: This is the one of whom the prophet Isaiah spoke when he said, “The voice of one crying out in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight. ’”
text_cn: 这人便是那藉依撒意亚先知所预言的：“在旷野里有呼号者的声音：你们该当预备上主的道路，修直他的途径。”

text_en: Now John wore clothing of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
text_cn: 这若翰穿着骆驼毛做的衣服，腰间束着皮带，他的食物是蝗虫和野蜜。

text_en: Then the people of Jerusalem and all Judea were going out to him, and all the region along the Jordan,
text_cn: 那时，耶路撒冷、全犹太以及全约但河一带的人，都出来到他那里去，

text_en: and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
text_cn: 承认自己的罪过，并在约但河里受他的洗。

text_en: But when he saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
text_cn: 他见到许多法利塞人和撒杜塞人来受他的洗，就对他们说：“毒蛇的种类！谁指教你们逃避那即将来临的忿怒？
那么，就结与悔改相称的果实吧！

text_en: Do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our ancestor’; for I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children to Abraham.
text_cn: 你们自己不要思念说：我们有亚巴郎为父。我给你们说：天主能从这些石头给亚巴郎兴起子孙来。

text_en: Even now the ax is lying at the root of the trees; every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
text_cn: 斧子已放在树根上了，凡不结好果子的树，必被砍倒，投入火中。

text_en: “I baptize you with water for repentance, but one who is more powerful than I is coming after me; I am not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
text_cn: 我固然用水洗你们，为使你们悔改；但在我以后要来的那一位，比我更强，我连提他的鞋也不配，他要以圣神及火洗你们。

text_en: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor and will gather his wheat into the granary; but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire. ”
text_cn: 他的簸箕已在他手中，他要扬净自己的禾场，将他的麦粒收入仓内，至于糠秕（bǐ），却要用不灭的火焚烧。”

text_en: Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan, to be baptized by him.
text_cn: 那时，耶稣由加里肋亚来到约但河若翰那里，为受他的洗；

text_en: John would have prevented him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me? ”
text_cn: 但若翰想要阻止他说：“我本来需要受你的洗，而你却来就我吗？”

text_en: But Jesus answered him, “Let it be so now; for it is proper for us in this way to fulfill all righteousness. ” Then he consented.
text_cn: 耶稣回答他说：“你暂且容许吧！因为我们应当这样，以完成全义。”于是若翰容许了他。

text_en: And when Jesus had been baptized, just as he came up from the water, suddenly the heavens were opened to him and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him.
text_cn: 耶稣受洗后，立时从水里上来，忽然天为他开了。他看见天主圣神有如鸽子降下，来到他上面；

text_en: And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, the Beloved, with whom I am well pleased. ”
text_cn: 又有声音由天上说：“这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。”
